recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the common jurisdiction portion of FHIR-31835 without changing the broader substance-specific example bindings reviewed under FHIR-31836.
issue_request: FHIR-31835 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that SubstanceSpecification jurisdiction and language use the same bindings used elsewhere in FHIR, with countryOfOrigin using a required binding.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly named FHIR-31835. The likely application path was broader BRR MedDef binding work: 9ee11711505a added SubstanceDefinition.name.language, name.jurisdiction, and sourceMaterial.countryOfOrigin bindings; ba6dd4995575 later made name.language required/all-languages; f48feed3e0a later updated jurisdiction bindings to the THO jurisdiction value set. Before this reconciliation, countryOfOrigin and language were correct, but name.jurisdiction remained example strength without the common-binding marker.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists substancedefinition as an active BRR resource, so source/substancedefinition/structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml is in current build scope. FHIR-31543 and FHIR-31836 explain the broader substance terminology review and support leaving substance-specific value sets mostly at example strength; FHIR-31835 is narrower and concerns common language/jurisdiction/country bindings. FHIR-48492 later standardized jurisdiction bindings on http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/jurisdiction, which this source already used.
reconciliation: Changed SubstanceDefinition.name.jurisdiction from an example binding to an extensible common binding to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/jurisdiction. No changes were needed for SubstanceDefinition.name.language or SubstanceDefinition.sourceMaterial.countryOfOrigin because they already have the requested required bindings.
source_changes: source/substancedefinition/structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml: added elementdefinition-isCommonBinding and changed SubstanceDefinition.name.jurisdiction binding strength from example to extensible.
